### Describe the solution you'd like

Technically, server can accept both `INDEXED_VALUE_TYPE_KEYWORD_LIST` and `KeywordList` forms in `type` metadata of search attribute payloads. Therefore, SDKs need to be similarly lenient when reading search attributes coming from server.

Noticed while debugging https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-core/issues/1105

title: Adjust typed search attribute logic to be as lenient on `type` metadata as server is when deserializing
